segments.text: Good morning, and welcome back to EquiTips. My name is Nico Arvelo, and I'm joined by Emily Harrell with Rego Products.
segments.zh: 早上好，欢迎回到 EquiTips。我是 Nico Arvelo，和我一起的是 RegO Products 的 Emily Harrell。

segments.text: Hi, good to have you here.
Of course. Thank you, Emily. Thank you for having us. So where is here? Where are we?
segments.zh: 当然。谢谢你，Emily。谢谢你邀请我们。那么这里是哪里？我们在什么地方？

segments.text: We are actually in Rego manufacturing site in Elan, North Carolina.
segments.zh: 我们现在其实是在 RegO 位于北卡罗来纳州 Elon 的生产基地。

segments.text: Perfect. And how many total manufacturing plants do you have in the U.S.?
segments.zh: 好的。你们在美国一共有多少家生产工厂？

segments.text: For cryogenics, we have here in Elan, North Carolina, Allentown, Pennsylvania, as well as Tampa, Florida.
segments.zh: 低温产品方面，我们有这里的北卡罗来纳州 Elon，还有宾夕法尼亚州 Allentown，以及佛罗里达州 Tampa。

segments.text: Awesome. Great. And what are we looking at today? What do I have in my hand?
segments.zh: 太棒了。很好。那我们今天看的是什么？我手里拿的是什么？

segments.text: This is an SK Advantage Series Globe Valve. It's the best on the market. It provides a lot of value for our customers.
segments.zh: 这是一款 SK Advantage 系列截止阀。它是市场上最好的，为我们的客户提供了很大的价值。

segments.text: Perfect. And this is a new product for you guys?
segments.zh: 好的。这是你们的新产品吗？

segments.text: It's over 10 years old, but we have new features and benefits available, including sizes up to 3 inches and different end connections.
segments.zh: 它已经有 10 多年历史了，不过我们增加了新的功能和优点，包括最大 3 英寸的尺寸和不同的端部连接方式。

segments.text: Awesome. So tell me a little bit more about these features. What makes it better in a better competition?
segments.zh: 太棒了。那再多讲讲这些功能吧。是什么让它在竞争中更胜一筹？

segments.text: We have a spring-loaded cold seal packing system and a conical seat design. That combination makes it a lot easier to maintain.
segments.zh: 我们采用了弹簧加载的冷密封填料系统和锥形阀座设计。这种组合让它维护起来容易得多。

segments.text: But mostly it reduces your maintenance, so increases your uptime.
segments.zh: 但最主要的是它能减少维护工作，从而提高设备的正常运行时间。

segments.text: When you do have to maintain the valve, the one-piece seat design makes it very easy and fast.
segments.zh: 当你确实需要维护阀门时，一体式阀座设计让维护变得非常简单快捷。

segments.text: We also have the ergonomic hand wheel, which makes it very easy for operators in the field to turn.
segments.zh: 我们还有符合人体工学的手轮，让现场操作人员转动起来非常轻松。

segments.text: Great. So it sounds like a great product and a great company.
segments.zh: 很好。听起来这是一款很棒的产品，也是一家很棒的公司。

segments.text: Where can I buy this amazing product?
segments.zh: 在哪里能买到这款很棒的产品？

segments.text: You can contact your local distributor, including our valued partner, Ecogas, who's right down the street in North Carolina.
segments.zh: 你可以联系当地的经销商，包括我们重要的合作伙伴 EquiGas，它就在北卡罗来纳州，离这里不远。

segments.text: There you have it folks. Just call 844-EQUIGAS today.
segments.zh: 各位，就是这些了。今天就拨打 844-EQUIGAS 吧。
